## Key design decisions (recorded in the notes)
- The design's "FR-4 supplies the Khintchine theorem" is **false**: the published lacunary page has no Rademacher/Khintchine item. I added a local chain (Rademacher def → finite-block equidistribution → Khintchine theorem) plus a uniform-Mihlin piece lemma (4 added prerequisites), sourced to Grafakos App. C, Tao §5.5, Williams Prop. 5.1.
- The Mihlin theorem is homed on the FR-8 (CZ) page, not FR-6; deps follow the actual home. MT-17 interpolation is not consumed; FR-9/FR-10 are consumed only by the two recorded endpoint remarks.
- Endpoint leaves kept honest: the H¹ area-function remark quotes Williams Prop. 7.30(a) exactly; the L^∞ remark records the dyadic ladder (W Thm 7.19, Def 7.21, Prop 7.22) rather than an unproved failure theorem; the UW lecture-22 source could not be read reliably and was replaced with W §7.4–7.5.
- The sharp-cutoff counterexample proves the 1D non-integrability locally; the n≥2 failure is cited orientation only. The Sobolev item's converse now records the ±∞ convention needed for it to be exact.
